description: Dev Concepts Volume 2 teaches professionals how to understand client needs and build products they'll love. This 50-page e-book draws from 15 years of industry experience to guide you through discovering what truly matters to users. Learn requirements discovery, User-Centered Design, Jobs-To-Be-Done theory, UX fundamentals, and effective specification development. Perfect for developers who want to avoid wasting time on features nobody cares about. Part of a comprehensive 12-volume series covering all aspects of software development.
